objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the system that contains content, metadata, and undergoes versioning and release workflows

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or description of the document

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation used in document naming

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive number assigned per document type

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as editing or released

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary person responsible for creating the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who checks document content for technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing the document

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person who translates the document content

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group that has read-only access to the document

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content

attributes.name: pdf_format
attributes.description: Converted PDF version of the document

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language in which the document is written

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Document version in the original language

attributes.name: translated_version
attributes.description: Document version translated to another language

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration for which a document remains valid before requiring revalidation

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Length of time a document is retained in archive after invalidation

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document has been archived

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: IT systems related to or referenced by the document

attributes.name: company_or_area_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational scope where the document applies

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document supplementing a main document that is released with the main document and affects versioning

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment in the release workflow

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attachment has been archived

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-controlled document supplement that does not undergo the release cycle or versioning of the main document

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Description of the additional information

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Information or files contained in the additional info

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed modification to an existing document created without affecting the document version

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal such as created or completed

attributes.name: scheduled_for_implementation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposal is planned for document updates

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Formal request to extend the validity period of a document nearing expiration

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has lost validity

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to restore and revalidate a previously invalidated document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Collection of users and user groups assigned to receive document updates and notifications

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution method such as email or acknowledgement

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group of users assigned to the distribution

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: Individual person assigned to the distribution

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned roles and permissions in the system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to users such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person with access to the system and assigned roles

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Permissions granted to the user for document access and modification

objs.name: template
objs.description: Predefined document structure with placeholder fields and metadata tags

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document the template is designed for

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Office format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied during document approval workflow

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: Person who applied the signature

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: Stage in the release process where the signature was applied

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a document recipient that they have reviewed and understood the document

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: Person who provided the acknowledgement

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as confirmed or pending

attributes.name: date_confirmed
attributes.description: Date when acknowledgement was confirmed

objs.name: client
objs.description: Separate instance or tenant in a multi-client system

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether a document is visible in this client

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the client

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language of the client
